You can see a fridge. You can make out a closed oven. You make out a table. The table is massive. On the table you can see a knife. You make out a counter. yellow bell pepper
  white onion

  block of cheese

  fry the yellow bell pepper
  slice the white onion
  roast the white onion
  slice the purple potato
  fry the purple potato
  slice the red onion
  fry the red onion
  chop the block of cheese
  roast the block of cheese
  prepare meal
